examples.hanzi: 坐在电脑前，你的姿势要正确。
examples.pinyin: Zuò zài diànnǎo qián, nǐ de zīshì yào zhèngquè.
examples.english: When you sit at the computer, your posture should be correct.

examples.hanzi: 他摆了一个很帅的姿势让我拍照。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎi le yí ge hěn shuài de zīshì ràng wǒ pāizhào.
examples.english: He struck a cool pose for me to take a photo.

examples.hanzi: 宇宙中有数不清的星星。
examples.pinyin: Yǔzhòu zhōng yǒu shǔ bù qīng de xīngxing.
examples.english: There are countless stars in the universe.

examples.hanzi: 我从小就对宇宙充满好奇。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóngxiǎo jiù duì yǔzhòu chōngmǎn hàoqí.
examples.english: I have been full of curiosity about the universe since I was little.

examples.hanzi: 面试的时候不要紧张。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì de shíhou bú yào jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: Don't be nervous during the interview.

examples.hanzi: 我上周面试了三家公司。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shàng zhōu miànshì le sān jiā gōngsī.
examples.english: Last week I interviewed with three companies.

examples.hanzi: 这是最新的天气预报。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì zuìxīn de tiānqì yùbào.
examples.english: This is the latest weather forecast.

examples.hanzi: 你看过他最新的电影吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ kàn guo tā zuìxīn de diànyǐng ma?
examples.english: Have you seen his latest movie?

examples.hanzi: 我们的卧室在二楼。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de wòshì zài èr lóu.
examples.english: Our bedroom is on the second floor.

examples.hanzi: 他把卧室打扫得干干净净。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ wòshì dǎsǎo de gāngān-jìngjìng.
examples.english: He cleaned the bedroom until it was spotless.

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂远离市区，空气很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yuǎnlí shìqū, kōngqì hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This factory is far from the city, and the air is good.

examples.hanzi: 小朋友要远离危险的地方。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou yào yuǎnlí wēixiǎn de dìfang.
examples.english: Children should stay away from dangerous places.

examples.hanzi: 他正在写一个电视剧的剧本。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhèngzài xiě yí ge diànshìjù de jùběn.
examples.english: He is writing the script for a TV drama.

examples.hanzi: 演员们正在背剧本，准备明天的演出。
examples.pinyin: Yǎnyuánmen zhèngzài bèi jùběn, zhǔnbèi míngtiān de yǎnchū.
examples.english: The actors are memorizing their scripts to prepare for tomorrow's show.

examples.hanzi: 请问，你叫什么名字？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn, nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
examples.english: Excuse me, what is your name?

examples.hanzi: 请问去火车站怎么走？
examples.pinyin: Qǐngwèn qù huǒchēzhàn zěnme zǒu?
examples.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the train station?

examples.hanzi: 他的手指被门夹住了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒuzhǐ bèi mén jiā zhù le.
examples.english: His finger got caught in the door.

examples.hanzi: 她的手指又细又长，很适合弹钢琴。
examples.pinyin: Tā de shǒuzhǐ yòu xì yòu cháng, hěn shìhé tán gāngqín.
examples.english: Her fingers are slender and long, perfect for playing the piano.

examples.hanzi: 这份报告证实了我们的想法。
examples.pinyin: Zhè fèn bàogào zhèngshí le wǒmen de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: This report confirmed our idea.

examples.hanzi: 这个消息还没有得到证实。
examples.pinyin: Zhège xiāoxi hái méiyǒu dédào zhèngshí.
examples.english: This news has not yet been confirmed.

examples.hanzi: 迈阿密的冬天也很暖和。
examples.pinyin: Mài'āmì de dōngtiān yě hěn nuǎnhuo.
examples.english: Even winter in Miami is warm.

examples.hanzi: 他在迈阿密有一套海边的房子。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài Mài'āmì yǒu yí tào hǎibiān de fángzi.
examples.english: He has a house by the sea in Miami.

examples.hanzi: 我们一路上都在聊天。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen yílù shang dōu zài liáotiān.
examples.english: We chatted all the way.

examples.hanzi: 你也去机场吗？那我们正好一路。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yě qù jīchǎng ma? Nà wǒmen zhènghǎo yílù.
examples.english: Are you going to the airport too? Then we are going the same way.

examples.hanzi: 你有资格参加这个比赛。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ yǒu zīgé cānjiā zhège bǐsài.
examples.english: You are qualified to take part in this competition.

examples.hanzi: 他在这家公司工作了十年，资格很老。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài zhè jiā gōngsī gōngzuò le shí nián, zīgé hěn lǎo.
examples.english: He has worked at this company for ten years and has a lot of seniority.

examples.hanzi: 这位作家写过很多儿童故事。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi zuòjiā xiěguo hěn duō értóng gùshi.
examples.english: This author has written many children's stories.

examples.hanzi: 我最喜欢的作家来我们学校做讲座了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan de zuòjiā lái wǒmen xuéxiào zuò jiǎngzuò le.
examples.english: My favorite writer came to give a talk at our school.

examples.hanzi: 他上个月辞职了，现在在找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng ge yuè cízhí le, xiànzài zài zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: He resigned last month and is now looking for a new job.

examples.hanzi: 老板不同意她辞职。
examples.pinyin: Lǎobǎn bù tóngyì tā cízhí.
examples.english: The boss doesn't agree to her resigning.

examples.hanzi: 被告的律师要求重新调查。
examples.pinyin: Bèigào de lǜshī yāoqiú chóngxīn diàochá.
examples.english: The defendant's lawyer asked for a new investigation.

examples.hanzi: 法官问被告有没有什么要说的。
examples.pinyin: Fǎguān wèn bèigào yǒu méiyǒu shénme yào shuō de.
examples.english: The judge asked the defendant whether he had anything to say.

examples.hanzi: 他把钱包放在了桌子上。
examples.pinyin: Tā bǎ qiánbāo fàng zài le zhuōzi shang.
examples.english: He left his wallet on the table.

examples.hanzi: 这个钱包是我妈妈送给我的生日礼物。
examples.pinyin: Zhège qiánbāo shì wǒ māma sòng gěi wǒ de shēngrì lǐwù.
examples.english: This wallet was a birthday present from my mom.

examples.hanzi: 他是一个诚实的孩子，从来不说谎。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì yí ge chéngshí de háizi, cónglái bù shuō huǎng.
examples.english: He is an honest child who never lies.

examples.hanzi: 请你诚实地回答我的问题。
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ chéngshí de huídá wǒ de wèntí.
examples.english: Please answer my question honestly.

examples.hanzi: 他骂她是贱人，这样说话很不礼貌。
examples.pinyin: Tā mà tā shì jiànrén, zhèyàng shuō huà hěn bù lǐmào.
examples.english: He called her a nasty name, which is very rude.

examples.hanzi: 不要用“贱人”这样难听的话骂别人。
examples.pinyin: Bú yào yòng "jiànrén" zhèyàng nántīng de huà mà biéren.
examples.english: Don't curse at others with ugly words like "jiànrén."

examples.hanzi: 在这里停车是合法的吗？
examples.pinyin: Zài zhèlǐ tíng chē shì héfǎ de ma?
examples.english: Is it legal to park here?

examples.hanzi: 他们是合法夫妻，有结婚证。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen shì héfǎ fūqī, yǒu jiéhūn zhèng.
examples.english: They are a lawfully married couple and have a marriage certificate.

examples.hanzi: 我今晚吃粉丝汤。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jīnwǎn chī fěnsī tāng.
examples.english: I'm having glass noodle soup tonight.

examples.hanzi: 她的微博有一百万粉丝。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wēibó yǒu yì bǎi wàn fěnsī.
examples.english: She has a million followers on Weibo.

examples.hanzi: 谢天谢地，你没事！
examples.pinyin: Xiètiān-xièdì, nǐ méi shì!
examples.english: Thank goodness, you're okay!

examples.hanzi: 谢天谢地，雨终于停了。
examples.pinyin: Xiètiān-xièdì, yǔ zhōngyú tíng le.
examples.english: Thank goodness, the rain has finally stopped.

examples.hanzi: 快来救救这只受伤的小鸟！
examples.pinyin: Kuài lái jiùjiu zhè zhī shòushāng de xiǎo niǎo!
examples.english: Come quickly and save this injured little bird!

examples.hanzi: 求求你，救救我的孩子！
examples.pinyin: Qiúqiu nǐ, jiùjiu wǒ de háizi!
examples.english: Please, save my child!

examples.hanzi: 我在网上搜索了很多资料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài wǎng shang sōusuǒ le hěn duō zīliào.
examples.english: I searched for a lot of information online.

examples.hanzi: 警察正在搜索那座山。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá zhèngzài sōusuǒ nà zuò shān.
examples.english: The police are searching that mountain.

examples.hanzi: 我们好久没有一起吃饭了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen hǎojiǔ méiyǒu yìqǐ chī fàn le.
examples.english: We haven't had a meal together in a long time.

examples.hanzi: 你等了好久吗？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ děng le hǎojiǔ ma?
examples.english: Have you been waiting for a long time?

examples.hanzi: 这家工厂有两千多名工人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā gōngchǎng yǒu liǎng qiān duō míng gōngrén.
examples.english: This factory has more than two thousand workers.

examples.hanzi: 爸爸在一家汽车工厂上班。
examples.pinyin: Bàba zài yì jiā qìchē gōngchǎng shàngbān.
examples.english: My dad works at a car factory.

examples.hanzi: 这些书我想留给我的孙子。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē shū wǒ xiǎng liúgěi wǒ de sūnzi.
examples.english: I want to leave these books to my grandson.

examples.hanzi: 老师把靠窗的座位留给了新同学。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bǎ kào chuāng de zuòwèi liúgěi le xīn tóngxué.
examples.english: The teacher saved the seat by the window for the new classmate.

examples.hanzi: 今天真走运，刚到车站就来了一辆车。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān zhēn zǒuyùn, gāng dào chēzhàn jiù lái le yí liàng chē.
examples.english: I'm really in luck today; a bus came just as I got to the stop.

examples.hanzi: 你真走运，最后一张票被你买到了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ zhēn zǒuyùn, zuìhòu yì zhāng piào bèi nǐ mǎi dào le.
examples.english: You're lucky; you got the very last ticket.

examples.hanzi: 吸毒会毁掉一个人的一生。
examples.pinyin: Xīdú huì huǐdiào yí ge rén de yìshēng.
examples.english: Taking drugs can ruin a person's whole life.

examples.hanzi: 他因为吸毒被送进了戒毒所。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi xīdú bèi sòng jìn le jièdúsuǒ.
examples.english: He was sent to a rehab center for taking drugs.

examples.hanzi: 我想过一种独立的生活。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng guò yì zhǒng dúlì de shēnghuó.
examples.english: I want to live an independent life.

examples.hanzi: 这个孩子已经可以独立完成作业了。
examples.pinyin: Zhège háizi yǐjīng kěyǐ dúlì wánchéng zuòyè le.
examples.english: This child can already finish homework independently.

examples.hanzi: 新年的到来让大家都很兴奋。
examples.pinyin: Xīnnián de dàolái ràng dàjiā dōu hěn xīngfèn.
examples.english: The arrival of the New Year made everyone excited.

examples.hanzi: 客人到来之前，我们得先打扫房间。
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dàolái zhīqián, wǒmen děi xiān dǎsǎo fángjiān.
examples.english: We have to clean the room before the guests arrive.

examples.hanzi: 你去查查明天的天气吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù chácha míngtiān de tiānqì ba.
examples.english: Go and check tomorrow's weather.

examples.hanzi: 这个字我不认识，我得查查字典。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zì wǒ bú rènshi, wǒ děi chácha zìdiǎn.
examples.english: I don't know this character, so I need to look it up in the dictionary.

examples.hanzi: 决赛将在周日晚上举行。
examples.pinyin: Juésài jiāng zài zhōurì wǎnshang jǔxíng.
examples.english: The final will be held on Sunday evening.

examples.hanzi: 她在游泳决赛中拿了第二名。
examples.pinyin: Tā zài yóuyǒng juésài zhōng ná le dì-èr míng.
examples.english: She won second place in the swimming final.

examples.hanzi: 我们需要想一个更好的手段来解决问题。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen xūyào xiǎng yí ge gèng hǎo de shǒuduàn lái jiějué wèntí.
examples.english: We need to think of a better way to solve the problem.

examples.hanzi: 你不能用这种手段骗人。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ bù néng yòng zhè zhǒng shǒuduàn piàn rén.
examples.english: You can't use this kind of trick to cheat people.

examples.hanzi: 顾客可以随时退货。
examples.pinyin: Gùkè kěyǐ suíshí tuìhuò.
examples.english: Customers can return goods at any time.

examples.hanzi: 服务员对每位顾客都很热情。
examples.pinyin: Fúwùyuán duì měi wèi gùkè dōu hěn rèqíng.
examples.english: The waiter is friendly to every customer.

examples.hanzi: 这个农场养了很多牛和羊。
examples.pinyin: Zhège nóngchǎng yǎng le hěn duō niú hé yáng.
examples.english: This farm raises many cows and sheep.

examples.hanzi: 周末我们带孩子去农场摘草莓。
examples.pinyin: Zhōumò wǒmen dài háizi qù nóngchǎng zhāi cǎoméi.
examples.english: On the weekend we take the kids to the farm to pick strawberries.

examples.hanzi: 我家的网络今天特别慢。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā de wǎngluò jīntiān tèbié màn.
examples.english: The internet at my home is especially slow today.

examples.hanzi: 网络上的消息不一定都是真的。
examples.pinyin: Wǎngluò shang de xiāoxi bù yídìng dōu shì zhēn de.
examples.english: Not everything you read online is true.

examples.hanzi: 我的口袋里只有几块钱。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de kǒudài lǐ zhǐyǒu jǐ kuài qián.
examples.english: I only have a few yuan in my pocket.

examples.hanzi: 外套的口袋太小，放不下手机。
examples.pinyin: Wàitào de kǒudài tài xiǎo, fàng bú xià shǒujī.
examples.english: The jacket pocket is too small to hold a phone.

examples.hanzi: 你什么时候方便？我们见个面吧。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ shénme shíhou fāngbiàn? Wǒmen jiàn ge miàn ba.
examples.english: When is convenient for you? Let's meet up.

examples.hanzi: 这里买东西很方便，楼下就有超市。
examples.pinyin: Zhèlǐ mǎi dōngxi hěn fāngbiàn, lóu xià jiù yǒu chāoshì.
examples.english: Shopping is convenient here; there's a supermarket downstairs.

examples.hanzi: 你来得正好，这是个好时机。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ lái de zhènghǎo, zhè shì ge hǎo shíjī.
examples.english: You came at just the right time; this is a good opportunity.

examples.hanzi: 他一直在等待合适的时机。
examples.pinyin: Tā yìzhí zài děngdài héshì de shíjī.
examples.english: He has been waiting for the right moment.

examples.hanzi: 这辆车有点毛病，需要修一修。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liàng chē yǒudiǎn máobìng, xūyào xiū yi xiū.
examples.english: There's something wrong with this car; it needs repair.

examples.hanzi: 他有个坏毛病，就是爱迟到。
examples.pinyin: Tā yǒu ge huài máobìng, jiù shì ài chídào.
examples.english: He has a bad habit: he loves being late.

examples.hanzi: 印度的食物以香料闻名。
examples.pinyin: Yìndù de shíwù yǐ xiāngliào wénmíng.
examples.english: Indian food is famous for its spices.

examples.hanzi: 我朋友下个月要去印度工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ péngyou xià ge yuè yào qù Yìndù gōngzuò.
examples.english: My friend is going to work in India next month.

examples.hanzi: 学外语最好多和别人交流。
examples.pinyin: Xué wàiyǔ zuìhǎo duō hé biéren jiāoliú.
examples.english: When learning a foreign language, it's best to communicate with others often.

examples.hanzi: 我们在网上交流学习经验。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zài wǎng shang jiāoliú xuéxí jīngyàn.
examples.english: We exchange study experiences online.

examples.hanzi: 他请了最好的律师为自己辩护。
examples.pinyin: Tā qǐng le zuì hǎo de lǜshī wèi zìjǐ biànhù.
examples.english: He hired the best lawyer to defend him.

examples.hanzi: 你不用为他辩护，他自己知道错了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyòng wèi tā biànhù, tā zìjǐ zhīdào cuò le.
examples.english: You don't need to defend him; he knows he was wrong.

examples.hanzi: 她每天早上都要打扮一个小时。
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang dōu yào dǎban yí ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: She spends an hour getting dressed up every morning.

examples.hanzi: 孩子们把圣诞树打扮得很漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Háizimen bǎ shèngdànshù dǎban de hěn piàoliang.
examples.english: The children decorated the Christmas tree beautifully.

examples.hanzi: 你起码应该先打个电话。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qǐmǎ yīnggāi xiān dǎ ge diànhuà.
examples.english: You should at least have called first.

examples.hanzi: 这双鞋起码要一百块。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng xié qǐmǎ yào yì bǎi kuài.
examples.english: These shoes cost at least a hundred yuan.

examples.hanzi: 嫌犯已经被警察抓住了。
examples.pinyin: Xiánfàn yǐjīng bèi jǐngchá zhuā zhù le.
examples.english: The suspect has been caught by the police.

examples.hanzi: 警察把嫌犯带回了警察局。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá bǎ xiánfàn dài huí le jǐngchájú.
examples.english: The police took the suspect back to the station.

examples.hanzi: 这次会议是公开的，谁都可以参加。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì shì gōngkāi de, shéi dōu kěyǐ cānjiā.
examples.english: This meeting is open to the public, so anyone can attend.

examples.hanzi: 他公开向大家道歉了。
examples.pinyin: Tā gōngkāi xiàng dàjiā dàoqiàn le.
examples.english: He apologized to everyone publicly.

examples.hanzi: 我的行李太重了，你能帮我吗？
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xíngli tài zhòng le, nǐ néng bāng wǒ ma?
examples.english: My luggage is too heavy; can you help me?

examples.hanzi: 行李放在后备厢里了。
examples.pinyin: Xíngli fàng zài hòubèixiāng lǐ le.
examples.english: The luggage is in the trunk.

examples.hanzi: 玛丽正在学中文。
examples.pinyin: Mǎlì zhèngzài xué Zhōngwén.
examples.english: Mary is learning Chinese.

examples.hanzi: 你认识玛丽吗？她是我同事。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ rènshi Mǎlì ma? Tā shì wǒ tóngshì.
examples.english: Do you know Mary? She is my coworker.
